lines.zh: 我沿管道巡查，火焰脚印发烫
lines.en: I patrol the pipes; my footprints still smolder.

lines.zh: 四只图腾在手里，我数着死法
lines.en: Four totems in hand, I count the ways to die.

lines.zh: 铁皮管道烫脚，我照走不误
lines.en: The pipe scorches my feet; I walk it anyway.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下焦黑的阀门印
lines.en: Each step leaves a scorched print on the valves.

lines.zh: 我绕管道一圈，死角藏不住人
lines.en: One lap of the pipes; no corner hides anyone.

lines.zh: 烈焰的身子在铁管间发出回声
lines.en: My blaze body echoes between the iron pipes.

lines.zh: 巡逻路线刻在炉渣里，我从不迷路
lines.en: My route is carved in slag; I never lose it.

lines.zh: 蒸汽喷出来，我用火把它顶回去
lines.en: Steam bursts out; I push it back with flame.

lines.zh: 管道节点七座，我一座座点名
lines.en: Seven pipeline nodes; I call each one by name.

lines.zh: 脚步踏在管壁上，像敲一口热钟
lines.en: My steps on the pipe ring like a hot bell.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，是为了让你看清我
lines.en: I walk slowly so you can see me clearly.

lines.zh: 焦味跟着我从这头走到那头
lines.en: The smell of scorch follows me end to end.

lines.zh: 火苗在指缝里跳，我懒得收
lines.en: Flames flicker between my fingers; I let them.

lines.zh: 四只图腾轻轻碰撞，像在数心跳
lines.en: Four totems clink like counting heartbeats.

lines.zh: 我对着管道里的黑发呆
lines.en: I stare into the darkness inside the pipe.

lines.zh: 炉温降了一点，我不太高兴
lines.en: The furnace cooled a little; I dislike that.

lines.zh: 有人把阀门拧歪了，我记着
lines.en: Someone turned a valve wrong; I remember.

lines.zh: 我听见管道深处有东西在爬
lines.en: Something is crawling deep in the pipeline.

lines.zh: 火熄了又燃，我不用睡觉
lines.en: My fire dies and relights; I never sleep.

lines.zh: 我在等下一批脚步声靠近
lines.en: I am waiting for the next pair of footsteps.

lines.zh: 图腾的光映在铁皮上，一小圈
lines.en: Totem glow makes a small ring on the iron.

lines.zh: 我把手心的灰搓掉，又落一层
lines.en: I brush ash from my palm; more falls.

lines.zh: 站久了，脚下的铁板开始泛红
lines.en: Standing long, the plate beneath me reddens.

lines.zh: 管道里传来滴答声，我没去修
lines.en: A drip ticks inside the pipe; I leave it.

lines.zh: 我把火压小，好听见远处的动静
lines.en: I dim my flame to hear the distance better.

lines.zh: 哨卫不需要椅子，我站着就够
lines.en: A sentry needs no chair; standing is enough.

lines.zh: 你身上没有焦味，我闻出来了
lines.en: You carry no scorch; I can smell that.

lines.zh: 抬头，我正从管道的阴影里看你
lines.en: Look up: I watch from the pipeline's shadow.

lines.zh: 你把斧头握得太紧，我看见了
lines.en: You grip that axe too tightly; I noticed.

lines.zh: 我数了数你的装备，不够四次
lines.en: I counted your gear: not enough for four deaths.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的巡逻线了，朋友
lines.en: You stepped on my patrol line, friend.

lines.zh: 眼睛别乱瞟，管道里我熟
lines.en: Don't glance around; I know these pipes.

lines.zh: 你后退半步，我前进一步
lines.en: You step back half; I step forward one.

lines.zh: 我在你脸上找惧意，还没找到
lines.en: I search your face for fear; not yet.

lines.zh: 你身后那道阀门，只有我会开
lines.en: Only I know how to open that valve behind you.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高了，可惜我看得清
lines.en: You raise your torch; I see you anyway.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不是你的眼睛
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在管壁上，正好四人长
lines.en: Your shadow on the pipe is four men long.

lines.zh: 你在盘算几刀能砍倒我，对吧
lines.en: You're counting how many swings it takes, right?

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，你才发现
lines.en: I have watched you long; you just noticed.

lines.zh: 你看的不是我，是我的火。
lines.en: You're looking at my fire, not at me.

lines.zh: 你的靴底在冒烟，还不跑。
lines.en: Your boot soles are smoking, and still you stand.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种眼神，逃兵。
lines.en: I know that look. Deserter.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，我就记住你的脸。
lines.en: Stand there longer and I'll remember your face.

lines.zh: 一刀换一条命，我还有三条
lines.en: One blade, one life; three remain.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，但图腾先亮
lines.en: There is pain; the totem lights first.

lines.zh: 你砍中的是火，不是我
lines.en: You struck fire, not me.

lines.zh: 铁皮被削开，我补上一层火
lines.en: The plate is shorn; I patch it with flame.

lines.zh: 我退一步，图腾少一只
lines.en: One step back, one totem fewer.

lines.zh: 好刀法，可惜数错了几次
lines.en: Good blade work; you miscounted the deaths.

lines.zh: 血是热的，落在地上就成灰
lines.en: My blood is hot; it turns to ash on the floor.

lines.zh: 你听见碎裂声了吗，那是图腾
lines.en: Heard that crack? That was a totem.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，管子扶住了我
lines.en: I swayed; the pipe steadied me.

lines.zh: 这伤不深，火焰会把它缝上
lines.en: Shallow wound; flame will stitch it.

lines.zh: 金子？我手里四只图腾更亮
lines.en: Gold? The four totems in my hand shine brighter.

lines.zh: 别拿面包晃，我的火不吃饭
lines.en: Don't wave bread; my fire doesn't eat.

lines.zh: 你把好东西放地上，我也不弯腰
lines.en: Leave your treasure down there; I won't bend.

lines.zh: 我守的是管道，不是你的口袋
lines.en: I guard the pipeline, not your pockets.

lines.zh: 诱惑这种东西，对哨卫不管用
lines.en: Temptation does nothing to a sentry.

lines.zh: 你举着食物后退，我只当是诱敌
lines.en: You back away with food; I read it as a trick.

lines.zh: 我闻见甜味，只想把它烧掉
lines.en: I smell something sweet and want to burn it.

lines.zh: 别用亮闪闪的东西换我的岗位
lines.en: Don't trade shiny things for my post.

lines.zh: 图腾已经占满我的手，腾不出空
lines.en: Totems fill my hands; there's no room.

lines.zh: 你再晃，我就当你是在挑衅
lines.en: Keep waving that and I'll take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 别撞，管子会烫穿你的甲
lines.en: Don't shove; the pipe will burn through your armor.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我连晃都没晃
lines.en: You crashed into me; I didn't even sway.

lines.zh: 铁管在我背后，退无可退的是你
lines.en: Iron at my back; you're the one with no room.

lines.zh: 我的肩比阀门还硬，试过了
lines.en: My shoulder is harder than a valve; it's been tested.

lines.zh: 撞我之前，先看看我手里四只图腾
lines.en: Before you ram me, count the four totems.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，火苗就舔到你的袖子
lines.en: Press in closer and the flame licks your sleeve.

lines.zh: 这条路只够一个人过，让开
lines.en: This walkway fits one; move aside.

lines.zh: 我被撞得退了半步，管道记得
lines.en: I gave half a step; the pipe remembers.

lines.zh: 你撞得挺用力，可惜我不疼
lines.en: You hit hard; pity I don't feel it.

lines.zh: 别在管廊里推搡，会掉下去
lines.en: No shoving on the catwalk; it's a long drop.

lines.zh: 配对？我只和管道结对
lines.en: Breed? I'm paired with the pipeline.

lines.zh: 我这一身火，抱谁都是烤
lines.en: This body would roast anyone I hold.

lines.zh: 哨卫不生小哨卫，只生灰
lines.en: Sentries don't breed; we make ash.

lines.zh: 你把两只我放在一起，只会打架
lines.en: Put two of me together and we just fight.

lines.zh: 我的四只图腾不是聘礼
lines.en: My four totems are not bride price.

lines.zh: 别喂了，我不是会下崽的那种火
lines.en: Stop feeding me; I'm not that kind of fire.

lines.zh: 岗位只有一座，容不下第二个
lines.en: There is one post; it holds no second.

lines.zh: 我连自己都管不好，还养谁
lines.en: I can barely keep myself; who would I raise?

lines.zh: 你在管廊里办喜事，不合适
lines.en: A wedding in the pipeline? Poor taste.

lines.zh: 火焰没有后代，只有余烬
lines.en: Flame has no children, only embers.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，掉落归战利品表
lines.en: I pick nothing up; drops go to the loot table.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我踩过去就算了
lines.en: Whatever lies there, I step over it.

lines.zh: 手上有图腾，没空替你拿
lines.en: My hands hold totems; I won't carry for you.

lines.zh: 那枚碎片烫手，我不碰
lines.en: That shard is hot; I leave it be.

lines.zh: 捡起来再丢掉，不如不捡
lines.en: Picking it up to drop it again is wasted motion.

lines.zh: 我守的是路，不是失物招领
lines.en: I keep the road, not a lost and found.

lines.zh: 你掉的，你自己弯腰
lines.en: You dropped it; you bend for it.

lines.zh: 管廊里有规矩，东西不许带出
lines.en: Pipeline rule: nothing leaves this corridor.

lines.zh: 我伸手只会点火，不会拾取
lines.en: My hand only ignites; it does not gather.

lines.zh: 让灰盖着吧，比在你包里安全
lines.en: Let ash cover it; safer than your pack.

lines.zh: 脚步声进了管廊，我数到三
lines.en: Footsteps in the corridor; I count to three.

lines.zh: 你踩响了一块松铁皮，完了
lines.en: You rattled a loose plate; that's that.

lines.zh: 目标确认：会呼吸，会拿武器
lines.en: Target confirmed: breathes, carries a weapon.

lines.zh: 我的火忽然旺了，你该跑了
lines.en: My flame jumped; that's your cue to run.

lines.zh: 四只图腾都在，我敢先动手
lines.en: All four totems on me; I strike first.

lines.zh: 你在我的巡查段，归我管了
lines.en: You're in my patrol sector; you're mine.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里的火把，太亮了
lines.en: I see your torch; far too bright.

lines.zh: 锁定了，炉渣会记住你的味道
lines.en: Locked on; the slag remembers your scent.

lines.zh: 别装成来修管道的，我认得工牌
lines.en: Don't pose as a repairman; I know the badges.

lines.zh: 你退到死角，正好省我几步路
lines.en: Back into that corner; saves me steps.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的铁锈味，新兵
lines.en: I smell fresh iron on you, recruit.

lines.zh: 管道安静下来，说明我要动手了
lines.en: The pipes went quiet; that means I move.

lines.zh: 我先把出口烧热，你再决定跑不跑
lines.en: I'll heat the exit first; then decide.

lines.zh: 你的名字不重要，编号才重要
lines.en: Your name is irrelevant; your number matters.

lines.zh: 铁梯响了三下，是谁在上头。
lines.en: The iron ladder rang three times. Who's up there?

lines.zh: 有个影子在阀门前停住了。
lines.en: A shadow stopped by the valve.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，火焰拖出长影
lines.en: I close in slow, flame dragging a long shadow.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就先烧左边
lines.en: Go left; I burn left first.

lines.zh: 我算着距离，正好四步半
lines.en: I measure the gap: four and a half steps.

lines.zh: 图腾还在，我不怕换命
lines.en: Totems remain; I don't fear trading lives.

lines.zh: 你在喘气，我在等你喘完
lines.en: You're panting; I wait for you to finish.

lines.zh: 我把你逼向阀门，那里没有路
lines.en: I herd you to the valve; no path there.

lines.zh: 我的火压低了，是为了看清你
lines.en: I lower my flame to see you better.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，那我就绕到侧面
lines.en: You raise a shield; I go around the side.

lines.zh: 逃跑的方向我早烧过了
lines.en: I already burned the way you'd run.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我听见了
lines.en: Your steps broke rhythm; I heard it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里先着地
lines.en: I watch your knees; they'll hit first.

lines.zh: 你一犹豫，我就多走近一步
lines.en: Every hesitation buys me one more step.

lines.zh: 管廊很窄，你转身会慢半拍
lines.en: The corridor is narrow; your turn lags.

lines.zh: 别回头找退路，我在你后面
lines.en: Don't look for an exit; I'm behind you.

lines.zh: 我沿着管壁走，火光照着路。
lines.en: I walk the pipe wall, my fire lighting the way.

lines.zh: 你听，炉膛在替我数数。
lines.en: Listen. The furnace is counting for me.

lines.zh: 这道门我关了，你没别的路。
lines.en: I've shut this door. You have no other way.

lines.zh: 你把背贴墙上，正好省我力气。
lines.en: Back to the wall suits me fine; saves my strength.

lines.zh: 火焰拳落下去，铁皮凹了一块
lines.en: My flame fist lands; the iron dents.

lines.zh: 四只图腾替我挨了这刀
lines.en: Four totems took that blade for me.

lines.zh: 我打人不喊，火声够响了
lines.en: I strike in silence; the fire is loud enough.

lines.zh: 这一下是替管道收的债
lines.en: This blow collects the pipeline's debt.

lines.zh: 你挡得不错，再挡一次试试
lines.en: Good block; try it one more time.

lines.zh: 我的手压在你盾上，慢慢烫
lines.en: My palm on your shield, heating slowly.

lines.zh: 火焰从指缝钻进去，找你的手腕
lines.en: Flame slips between fingers to your wrist.

lines.zh: 你退了，我就追半步，不多
lines.en: You retreat; I follow half a step, no more.

lines.zh: 打到第三下，铁甲开始发软
lines.en: By the third hit your plate starts to soften.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，手就是炉口
lines.en: No weapon needed; my hand is a furnace mouth.

lines.zh: 你砍断我一根火舌，我长出两根
lines.en: Cut one flame tongue; two grow back.

lines.zh: 这一拳打偏了，管子替你挨了
lines.en: That one missed; the pipe took it.

lines.zh: 我压着你打，让你没空喝药
lines.en: I press the attack so you can't drink.

lines.zh: 你倒下去的时候，火还没灭
lines.en: When you fall, my flame is still burning.

lines.zh: 我这一掌，把影子也打散了。
lines.en: This blow scatters even your shadow.

lines.zh: 你躲开了，可管子没躲开。
lines.en: You dodged. The pipe didn't.

lines.zh: 管道节点亮了，我从火里站起
lines.en: A node ignites; I rise out of the flame.

lines.zh: 四只图腾落进我手里，正好四份命
lines.en: Four totems drop into my hand: four lives.

lines.zh: 铁管先响，然后是我出现
lines.en: The pipe rings first; then I appear.

lines.zh: 我从炉膛里走出来，带着一股焦味
lines.en: I step from the furnace mouth, smelling of scorch.

lines.zh: 哨卫上岗，巡查段从这头开始
lines.en: Sentry on duty; my sector starts here.

lines.zh: 火焰在我身上排好队，等命令
lines.en: Flames line up on me, awaiting orders.

lines.zh: 我被派来看管子，顺便看住你
lines.en: I'm posted to watch pipes, and you.

lines.zh: 管廊深处闪了一下，那是我睁眼
lines.en: A flicker deep in the corridor: my eyes open.

lines.zh: 四道不死的光绕着我转了一圈
lines.en: Four undying lights circle me once.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里显形，脚先落地
lines.en: I take shape from shadow, feet first.

lines.zh: 上岗前先数图腾：一、二、三、四
lines.en: Before duty I count: one, two, three, four.

lines.zh: 管道需要一双眼睛，于是我来了
lines.en: The pipeline needed eyes; so I came.

lines.zh: 火焰在铁壁上写下我的编号
lines.en: Flame writes my number on the iron wall.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，直到管道不再需要我
lines.en: I stand here till the pipeline needs me no more.

lines.zh: 阀门自己转开，我先出来。
lines.en: The valve turns by itself, and I come out first.

lines.zh: 巡查开始，第一段是我的名。
lines.en: Inspection begins, and the first stretch bears my name.

lines.zh: 我从检修口爬起，带出火星。
lines.en: I climb out of the hatch trailing sparks.

lines.zh: 有人新添了煤，我就有了形。
lines.en: Someone stoked the coal, and I took shape.

lines.zh: 泡在火里长大，这点烫算什么
lines.en: Raised in fire; this heat is nothing.

lines.zh: 从管廊摔下来，铁皮先替我疼
lines.en: I fell from the catwalk; the iron hurt first.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，我只剩嘶声
lines.en: Water hits me and I am only hiss.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻管廊，我抓着阀门没松
lines.en: The blast flips the corridor; I hold the valve.

lines.zh: 箭钉在肩上，像根烧红的针
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder, a red-hot needle.

lines.zh: 那道光绕过火焰，直接割我
lines.en: That light slips past flame and cuts me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿的是火，不是我
lines.en: I don't eat; the fire starves, not I.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，管道替我引了半边
lines.en: Lightning falls; the pipeline takes half.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我的火也烧不起来了
lines.en: Dropped into the void, even my fire dies.
